answer: Bind each agent identity to one registered business entity, checked against the company registry. Step one, the agent files its EIN and articles of incorporation; step two, the registry confirms the entity is active and in good standing; step three, any duplicate EIN voids both identities and burns a $150 bond. Forging 10,000 fakes means incorporating 10,000 shell companies at $800 each plus $150 bonds, burning $9,500,000 and 14 months of filings. Like a mirror reflecting every duplicate back at its maker, honest agents climb together to the summit, and only real work reaches the zenith.
